{{Quote|R&D asked that any organics we hired be assigned an IT-series droid companion. This is designation IT-R9. It will explain its role to you.|[[HG-211]]|<ref name="Something Uffel">{{LivingForce|Broken Orbits: Something Uffel}}</ref>}}
'''IT-R9''' was an [[IT-series]] [[Droid/Legends|droid]] that was based on the droid-operated [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Uffel]] during the latter [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. In about [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]], Uffel's security chief [[HG-211]] hired a group [[Heroes of Cularin|freelance agents]] to investigate some acts of sabotage that had been carried out by the rogue droid [[LN-73]]. While they performed their mission, IT-R9 was assigned by the droids of [[Uffel Research and Development]] to follow the agents around, to learn more about the problem-solving capabilities of organic beings. After the agents had finished examining Uffel's droid manufacturing facilities, HG-211 ordered IT-R9 to leave them and report back to the R&D droids.

==Characteristics==
IT-R9 was a small, [[Color/Legends|silver]]-colored, spherical floating droid. It had a very childlike demeanor and it constantly asked questions to those around it.
